summary: Lead research for MyTrip Export (itinerary export/sharing). Focus on tourism bureaus and destination marketing orgs that publish travel guides and itineraries.

leads.fit_rationale: Publishes visitor information and travel guides for Ashtabula County; could use a branded itinerary export tool for trip planning and guide distribution.
Promotes local travel experiences and provides travel guides; MyTrip Export could power shareable itineraries and downloadable plans.
State tourism portal highlighting itineraries and destinations; exportable itineraries can improve trip planning across regions.
City-level tourism bureau that markets Cleveland; itinerary export/print/share can enhance visitor planning and conversions.
Regional tourism organization that promotes attractions; itinerary export can package weekend plans and event-based visits.

branding_quality_assessment.notes: No visual-analysis JSON was available at runtime. Branding assessment deferred until screenshot analysis report exists.

site_improvements: Add a clear, branded hero section with a one-line value proposition (e.g., 'Export a full trip itinerary in one click').
Include a visible 'Export' call-to-action (PDF/Calendar/Share Link) above the fold.
Show example itineraries (weekend, family, wine trail) with export previews to demonstrate value quickly.
Provide export formats (PDF, ICS calendar, shareable link) with icons for clarity.
Add trust signals: supported destinations, tourism partners, and a short testimonial strip.
Improve information hierarchy: itinerary builder → preview → export button → email/share.
Add accessibility checks (contrast, font size) and mobile-first layout constraints.
Integrate a lightweight map preview with day-by-day route summaries.

possible_issues: Potential misalignment if the layout is not centered or consistent across sections.
Risk of excessive whitespace or uneven margins in itinerary cards if grid is not normalized.
If typography lacks hierarchy, the export value may be unclear at first glance.

whitelabel_potential.reason: Itinerary export tools can be easily branded for tourism bureaus and agencies; if branding is minimal, whitelabeling should be straightforward.

action_next: When the sitemap_screenshots visual-analysis JSON becomes available, merge its findings into this MVP file.
Identify 2–3 additional tourism bureaus or travel agencies in Northeast Ohio for outreach.
Draft a 3-step outreach email emphasizing itinerary export + travel guide integration.
